entities.summary: The Roman Catholic Diocese of Kiyinda–Mityana is a suffragan diocese of the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Kampala in Uganda. The diocese serves the Catholic faithful in the cities of Kiyinda and Mityana and covers an area of 11,965 square kilometres (4,620 sq mi), making it one of the largest dioceses by area in the Kampala Ecclesiastical Province.
